{{Top|leg}}
A '''crystal factory''' was a small, gracefully designed building operated by [[Galactic Crystal Creations]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garnib]] for the purpose of creating [[Garnib crystal]]. Designed by the greatest of the [[Balinaka]] [[Sculptor/Legends|sculptors]], they were a mixture of sweeping curves, sharp angles and motorized sculptures. Designed to be modular so that entire sections could be replaced to better suit the artistic needs of the [[Artisan/Legends|artisans]] creating Garnib crystal, each crystal factory also contained [[crystal mill]]s, rooms that held the [[sonic bath]]s responsible for the final shaping of the crystal. Each factory was located near an active [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]], or a fissure on the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] floor, and geothermal energy was used to power the factories.
